thig3.2:1.1: catukkhattuṃ pañcakkhattuṃ vihārā upanikkhamiṃ | aladdhā cetaso santiṃ citte avasavattini. || ||
thig3.2:2.1: sā bhikkhuniṃ upāgacchiṃ yā me saddhāyikā ahu | sā me dhammaṃ adesesi khandhāyatanadhātuyo. || ||
thig3.2:3.1: tassā dhammaṃ suṇitvāna yathā maṃ anusāsi sā | sattāhaṃ ekapallaṅke nisīdiṃ pītisukhasamappitā | aṭṭhamiyā pāde pasāresiṃ tamokkhandhaṃ padāliya. || || Uttamā. ||
